````
import { validateGroundedExplanation } from "./explanation-grounding";
import rawSummary from "../../data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/analytics/intelligence_summary.json";
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

type MetricRow = {
  stage?: string;
  product?: string;
  source?: string;
  team?: string;
  location?: string;
  lead_count: number;
  total_lead_value: number;
  average_lead_value: number;
  average_days_in_stage: number;
  median_days_in_stage: number;
  value_share_percent: number;
};

type DemoSummary = {
  project: string;
  dataset_classification: string;
  data_version: string;
  random_seed: number;
  observation_window: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    calendar_months: number;
  };
  overall_summary: {
    source_leads_analyzed: number;
    canonical_rows_processed: number;
    total_lead_value: number;
    average_lead_value: number;
    average_days_in_stage: number;
    median_days_in_stage: number;
  };
  highest_observed_groups: {
    highest_value_stage: { stage: string; total_lead_value: number };
    highest_value_product: { product: string; total_lead_value: number };
    highest_value_source: { source: string; total_lead_value: number };
    highest_average_age_stage: {
      stage: string;
      average_days_in_stage: number;
    };
  };
  dimensions: {
    stage: MetricRow[];
    product: MetricRow[];
    source: MetricRow[];
    team: MetricRow[];
    location: MetricRow[];
  };
  interpretation: string[];
  limitations: string[];
};

type Evidence = {
  source_id: string;
  source_type: string;
  group?: string;
  metric?: string;
  value?: number;
  unit?: string;
  finding: string;
  data_version: string;
  method_version: string;
  generated_at: string;
  quality_status: string;
  limitation: string;
};

type ReplyStatus = "SUPPORTED" | "UNSUPPORTED" | "MISSING_PARAMETER";

type DemoReply = {
  answer_id: string;
  status: ReplyStatus;
  intent: string | null;
  answer: string;
  explanation: string | null;
  explanation_status: "GENERATED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "SKIPPED";
  evidence_references: Evidence[];
  key_values: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>;
  metadata: {
    assistant_id: string;
    assistant_version: string;
    mode: string;
    llm_enabled: boolean;
    data_version: string;
    method_version: string;
    quality_status: string;
    generated_at: string;
  };
  limitation: string;
  suggested_follow_ups: string[];
};

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;
const METHOD_VERSION = "demo-assistant-rules-1.0.0";
const QUALITY_STATUS = "SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DESCRIPTIVE";

const LIMITATION =
  "All figures come from synthetic demonstration data. Results are descriptive, use currency-unspecified units, and do not establish causation, real-world outcomes, stage transitions, conversion rates, or seasonality.";

function format(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

function createReply(
  status: ReplyStatus,
  intent: string | null,
  answer: string,
  evidence: Array<{
    source_id: string;
    group?: string;
    metric?: string;
    value?: number;
    unit?: string;
    finding?: string;
  }> = [],
  keyValues: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> = {},
): DemoReply {
  const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    answer_id: `demo-assistant-${Date.now()}`,
    status,
    intent,
    answer,
    explanation: null,
    explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
    evidence_references: evidence.map((item) => ({
      source_id: item.source_id,
      source_type: "demo_intelligence_summary",
      ...(item.group !== undefined ? { group: item.group } : {}),
      ...(item.metric !== undefined ? { metric: item.metric } : {}),
      ...(item.value !== undefined ? { value: item.value } : {}),
      ...(item.unit !== undefined ? { unit: item.unit } : {}),
      finding: item.finding ?? answer,
      data_version: summary.data_version,
      method_version: METHOD_VERSION,
      generated_at: generatedAt,
      quality_status: QUALITY_STATUS,
      limitation: LIMITATION,
    })),
    key_values: keyValues,
    metadata: {
      assistant_id: "phase3-demo-grounded-assistant",
      assistant_version: "1.0.0",
      mode: "deterministic",
      llm_enabled: false,
      data_version: summary.data_version,
      method_version: METHOD_VERSION,
      quality_status: QUALITY_STATUS,
      generated_at: generatedAt,
    },
    limitation: LIMITATION,
    suggested_follow_ups: [
      "Which stage has the highest total lead value?",
      "Which product has the highest total lead value?",
      "Compare Won and Lost stages.",
      "What are the limitations?",
    ],
  };
}

export function answerDemoQuestion(question: unknown): DemoReply {
  if (typeof question !== "string" || !question.trim()) {
    return createReply(
      "MISSING_PARAMETER",
      null,
      "Please enter a question about the synthetic demo dataset.",
    );
  }

  if (question.length > 500) {
    return createReply(
      "UNSUPPORTED",
      null,
      "Questions must be 500 characters or fewer.",
    );
  }

  const normalized = question.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (
    normalized.includes("limitation") ||
    normalized.includes("conversion rate") ||
    normalized.includes("conversion rates") ||
    normalized.includes("transition history") ||
    normalized.includes("seasonality") ||
    normalized.includes("causation")
  ) {
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_limitations",
      summary.limitations.join(" "),
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-limitations",
          metric: "limitations",
          finding: summary.limitations.join(" "),
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("version") ||
    normalized.includes("random seed") ||
    normalized.includes("observation window")
  ) {
    const answer =
      `The dataset version is ${summary.data_version}, generated with seed ${summary.random_seed}. ` +
      `The observation window is ${summary.observation_window.start} to ${summary.observation_window.end}, ` +
      `covering ${summary.observation_window.calendar_months} calendar months.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_data_version",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-metadata",
          metric: "data_version",
          finding: answer,
        },
      ],
      {
        data_version: summary.data_version,
        random_seed: summary.random_seed,
        observation_start: summary.observation_window.start,
        observation_end: summary.observation_window.end,
      },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("summary") ||
    normalized.includes("how many leads") ||
    normalized.includes("dataset overview") ||
    normalized.includes("how was the analysis performed")
  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const answer =
      `This synthetic demonstration contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} source leads ` +
      `and ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows. Total observed lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units. Average lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_lead_value)} units. Mean current-stage age is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_days_in_stage)} days and median age is ` +
      `${format(stats.median_days_in_stage)} days. The dataset contains current-stage snapshots, not transition history.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_demo_summary",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "source_leads_analyzed",
          value: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
          unit: "leads",
          finding: `The dataset contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} synthetic source leads.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "canonical_rows_processed",
          value: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
          unit: "rows",
          finding: `The analytical process processed ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "total_lead_value",
          value: stats.total_lead_value,
          unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          finding: `Total observed lead value is ${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units.`,
        },
      ],
      {
        source_leads: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
        canonical_rows: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
        total_lead_value: stats.total_lead_value,
        average_lead_value: stats.average_lead_value,
        mean_days_in_stage: stats.average_days_in_stage,
        median_days_in_stage: stats.median_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const wantsHighestAge =
    normalized.includes("highest average age") ||
    normalized.includes("oldest stage") ||
    normalized.includes("longest");

  if (wantsHighestAge && normalized.includes("stage")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage;
    const answer =
      `${top.stage} has the highest average recorded age in this synthetic snapshot: ` +
      `${format(top.average_days_in_stage)} days. This does not explain why records remain in that stage.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_average_stage_age",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-highest-average-age",
          group: top.stage,
          metric: "average_days_in_stage",
          value: top.average_days_in_stage,
          unit: "days",
        },
      ],
      {
        stage: top.stage,
        average_days_in_stage: top.average_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const highestValue = normalized.includes("highest") ||
    normalized.includes("top") ||
    normalized.includes("most");

  if (highestValue && (normalized.includes("stage") || normalized.includes("funnel"))) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_stage;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_stage",
      `${top.stage} has the highest observed total lead value by stage: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-stage",
        group: top.stage,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { stage: top.stage, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (highestValue && normalized.includes("product")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_product;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_product",
      `${top.product} has the highest observed total lead value by product: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-product",
        group: top.product,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_source",
      `${top.source} has the highest observed total lead value by acquisition source: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-source",
        group: top.source,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { source: top.source, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("compare won and lost") ||
    (normalized.includes("won") && normalized.includes("lost"))
  ) {
    const won = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Won");
    const lost = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Lost");

    if (won && lost) {
      const answer =
        `In the current snapshot, Won contains ${won.lead_count} leads with total observed value ` +
````

````
  };
  highest_observed_groups: {
    highest_value_stage: { stage: string; total_lead_value: number };

};

  value?: number;
  unit?: string;
  finding: string;
  data_version: string;
  method_version: string;
  generated_at: string;
  quality_status: string;
  limitation: string;
};

type ReplyStatus = "SUPPORTED" | "UNSUPPORTED" | "MISSING_PARAMETER";

type DemoReply = {
  answer_id: string;

  intent: string | null;
  answer: string;
  explanation: string | null;
  explanation_status: "GENERATED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "SKIPPED";

};

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;
const METHOD_VERSION = "demo-assistant-rules-1.0.0";
const QUALITY_STATUS = "SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DESCRIPTIVE";

const LIMITATION =
  "All figures come from synthetic demonstration data. Results are descriptive, use currency-unspecified units, and do not establish causation, real-world outcomes, stage transitions, conversion rates, or seasonality.";

function format(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

function createReply(
  status: ReplyStatus,
  intent: string | null,
  answer: string,
  evidence: Array<{
    source_id: string;
    group?: string;
    metric?: string;
    value?: number;
    unit?: string;
    finding?: string;
  }> = [],
  keyValues: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> = {},
): DemoReply {
  const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    answer_id: `demo-assistant-${Date.now()}`,
    status,
    intent,
    answer,
    explanation: null,

    ],

}
````

````
  generated_at: string;
  quality_status: string;
  limitation: string;
};

type ReplyStatus = "SUPPORTED" | "UNSUPPORTED" | "MISSING_PARAMETER";

type DemoReply = {
  answer_id: string;
  status: ReplyStatus;
  intent: string | null;
  answer: string;
  explanation: string | null;
  explanation_status: "GENERATED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "SKIPPED";
  evidence_references: Evidence[];
  key_values: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>;
  metadata: {
    assistant_id: string;
    assistant_version: string;
    mode: string;
    llm_enabled: boolean;
    data_version: string;
    method_version: string;
    quality_status: string;
    generated_at: string;
  };
  limitation: string;
  suggested_follow_ups: string[];
};

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;
const METHOD_VERSION = "demo-assistant-rules-1.0.0";
const QUALITY_STATUS = "SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DESCRIPTIVE";

const LIMITATION =
  "All figures come from synthetic demonstration data. Results are descriptive, use currency-unspecified units, and do not establish causation, real-world outcomes, stage transitions, conversion rates, or seasonality.";

function format(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

function createReply(
  status: ReplyStatus,
  intent: string | null,
  answer: string,
  evidence: Array<{
    source_id: string;
    group?: string;
    metric?: string;
    value?: number;
    unit?: string;
    finding?: string;
  }> = [],
  keyValues: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> = {},
): DemoReply {
  const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    answer_id: `demo-assistant-${Date.now()}`,
    status,
    intent,
    answer,
    explanation: null,
    explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
    evidence_references: evidence.map((item) => ({
      source_id: item.source_id,
      source_type: "demo_intelligence_summary",
      ...(item.group !== undefined ? { group: item.group } : {}),
      ...(item.metric !== undefined ? { metric: item.metric } : {}),
      ...(item.value !== undefined ? { value: item.value } : {}),
      ...(item.unit !== undefined ? { unit: item.unit } : {}),
      finding: item.finding ?? answer,
      data_version: summary.data_version,
      method_version: METHOD_VERSION,
      generated_at: generatedAt,
      quality_status: QUALITY_STATUS,
      limitation: LIMITATION,
    })),
    key_values: keyValues,
    metadata: {
      assistant_id: "phase3-demo-grounded-assistant",
      assistant_version: "1.0.0",
      mode: "deterministic",
      llm_enabled: false,
      data_version: summary.data_version,
      method_version: METHOD_VERSION,
      quality_status: QUALITY_STATUS,
      generated_at: generatedAt,
    },
    limitation: LIMITATION,
    suggested_follow_ups: [
      "Which stage has the highest total lead value?",
      "Which product has the highest total lead value?",
      "Compare Won and Lost stages.",
      "What are the limitations?",
    ],
  };
}

export function answerDemoQuestion(question: unknown): DemoReply {
  if (typeof question !== "string" || !question.trim()) {
    return createReply(
      "MISSING_PARAMETER",
      null,
      "Please enter a question about the synthetic demo dataset.",
    );
  }

  if (question.length > 500) {
    return createReply(
      "UNSUPPORTED",
      null,
      "Questions must be 500 characters or fewer.",
    );
  }

  const normalized = question.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (
    normalized.includes("limitation") ||
    normalized.includes("conversion rate") ||
    normalized.includes("conversion rates") ||
    normalized.includes("transition history") ||
    normalized.includes("seasonality") ||
    normalized.includes("causation")
  ) {
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_limitations",
      summary.limitations.join(" "),
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-limitations",
          metric: "limitations",
          finding: summary.limitations.join(" "),
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("version") ||
    normalized.includes("random seed") ||
    normalized.includes("observation window")
  ) {
    const answer =
      `The dataset version is ${summary.data_version}, generated with seed ${summary.random_seed}. ` +
      `The observation window is ${summary.observation_window.start} to ${summary.observation_window.end}, ` +
      `covering ${summary.observation_window.calendar_months} calendar months.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_data_version",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-metadata",
          metric: "data_version",
          finding: answer,
        },
      ],
      {
        data_version: summary.data_version,
        random_seed: summary.random_seed,
        observation_start: summary.observation_window.start,
        observation_end: summary.observation_window.end,
      },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("summary") ||
    normalized.includes("how many leads") ||
    normalized.includes("dataset overview") ||
    normalized.includes("how was the analysis performed")
  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const answer =
      `This synthetic demonstration contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} source leads ` +
      `and ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows. Total observed lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units. Average lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_lead_value)} units. Mean current-stage age is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_days_in_stage)} days and median age is ` +
      `${format(stats.median_days_in_stage)} days. The dataset contains current-stage snapshots, not transition history.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_demo_summary",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "source_leads_analyzed",
          value: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
          unit: "leads",
          finding: `The dataset contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} synthetic source leads.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "canonical_rows_processed",
          value: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
          unit: "rows",
          finding: `The analytical process processed ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "total_lead_value",
          value: stats.total_lead_value,
          unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          finding: `Total observed lead value is ${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units.`,
        },
      ],
      {
        source_leads: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
        canonical_rows: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
        total_lead_value: stats.total_lead_value,
        average_lead_value: stats.average_lead_value,
        mean_days_in_stage: stats.average_days_in_stage,
        median_days_in_stage: stats.median_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const wantsHighestAge =
    normalized.includes("highest average age") ||
    normalized.includes("oldest stage") ||
    normalized.includes("longest");

  if (wantsHighestAge && normalized.includes("stage")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage;
    const answer =
      `${top.stage} has the highest average recorded age in this synthetic snapshot: ` +
      `${format(top.average_days_in_stage)} days. This does not explain why records remain in that stage.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_average_stage_age",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-highest-average-age",
          group: top.stage,
          metric: "average_days_in_stage",
          value: top.average_days_in_stage,
          unit: "days",
        },
      ],
      {
        stage: top.stage,
        average_days_in_stage: top.average_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const highestValue = normalized.includes("highest") ||
    normalized.includes("top") ||
    normalized.includes("most");

  if (highestValue && (normalized.includes("stage") || normalized.includes("funnel"))) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_stage;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_stage",
      `${top.stage} has the highest observed total lead value by stage: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-stage",
        group: top.stage,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { stage: top.stage, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (highestValue && normalized.includes("product")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_product;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_product",
      `${top.product} has the highest observed total lead value by product: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-product",
        group: top.product,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_source",
      `${top.source} has the highest observed total lead value by acquisition source: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-source",
        group: top.source,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { source: top.source, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("compare won and lost") ||
    (normalized.includes("won") && normalized.includes("lost"))
  ) {
    const won = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Won");
    const lost = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Lost");

    if (won && lost) {
      const answer =
        `In the current snapshot, Won contains ${won.lead_count} leads with total observed value ` +
        `${format(won.total_lead_value)} units and average age ${format(won.average_days_in_stage)} days. ` +
        `Lost contains ${lost.lead_count} leads with total observed value ${format(lost.total_lead_value)} units ` +
        `and average age ${format(lost.average_days_in_stage)} days. These are current-stage comparisons, not transition or conversion rates.`;

      return createReply(
        "SUPPORTED",
        "compare_won_lost",
        answer,
        [
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-won",
            group: "Won",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: won.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-lost",
            group: "Lost",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: lost.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
        ],
        {
          won_leads: won.lead_count,
          won_value: won.total_lead_value,
          won_average_age_days: won.average_days_in_stage,
          lost_leads: lost.lead_count,
          lost_value: lost.total_lead_value,
          lost_average_age_days: lost.average_days_in_stage,
        },
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("average age") ||
    normalized.includes("mean age") ||
    normalized.includes("average days") ||
    normalized.includes("median age")
  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const useMedian = normalized.includes("median");
    const value = useMedian
      ? stats.median_days_in_stage
      : stats.average_days_in_stage;
    const metric = useMedian ? "median_days_in_stage" : "average_days_in_stage";

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_average_stage_age",
      `The ${useMedian ? "median" : "mean"} recorded age across current-stage records is ${format(value)} days in the synthetic demo dataset.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-overall-age",
        metric,
        value,
        unit: "days",
      }],
      { [metric]: value },
    );
  }

  return createReply(
    "UNSUPPORTED",
    null,
    "I can answer questions grounded in this demo's summary, highest-value stage/product/source, current-stage age, Won-versus-Lost snapshot comparison, dataset version, and limitations. I cannot infer historical transitions, real conversion rates, causes, seasonality, or future outcomes.",
  );
}


/**
 * Keeps the deterministic answer authoritative.
 * Gemini may explain supported evidence, but may not invent or alter findings.
 */
export async function answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation(
  question: unknown,
): Promise<DemoReply> {
  const reply = answerDemoQuestion(question);

  if (reply.status !== "SUPPORTED") {
    return { ...reply, explanation: null, explanation_status: "SKIPPED" };
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim();

  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_only",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        timeout: 15000,
        retryOptions: { attempts: 1 },
      },
    });
    const prompt = [
      "You are explaining a deterministic answer from a synthetic CRM demonstration dataset.",
      "The deterministic answer and supplied evidence are authoritative. Explain them clearly in 2-4 sentences.",
      "Do not add or calculate numbers, rankings, facts, predictions, causal claims, conversion rates, or seasonality.",
      "Do not contradict or rewrite the deterministic answer.",
      "Mention that the dataset is synthetic where relevant and preserve the stated limitations.",
      "Question: " + String(question),
      "Deterministic answer: " + reply.answer,
      "Approved evidence: " + JSON.stringify(reply.evidence_references),
      "Approved key values: " + JSON.stringify(reply.key_values),
      "Data version: " + reply.metadata.data_version,
      "Method version: " + reply.metadata.method_version,
      "Limitations: " + reply.limitation,
    ].join("\n");

    const result = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || "gemini-3.8-flash",
      contents: prompt,
    });

const explanation = result.text?.trim();

if (!explanation || explanation.length > 2000) {
  throw new Error("Gemini returned an empty or oversized explanation.");
}

const grounding = validateGroundedExplanation(explanation, {
  deterministicAnswer: reply.answer,
  evidenceReferences: reply.evidence_references.map((item) => ({
    group: item.group,
    finding: item.finding,
    value: item.value,
    unit: item.unit,
    data_version: item.data_version,
    method_version: item.method_version,
    limitation: item.limitation,
  })),
  limitation: reply.limitation,
});

if (!grounding.valid) {
  console.warn(
    "[Demo Gemini explanation rejected by grounding validator]",
    grounding.reason,
  );
  throw new Error("Gemini explanation failed grounding validation.");
}


    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation,
      explanation_status: "GENERATED",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_with_gemini_explanation",
        llm_enabled: true,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    // Gemini failure must never remove the validated answer or its evidence.
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_fallback",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }
}
````

````
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage;
    const answer =
      `${top.stage} has the highest average recorded age in this synthetic snapshot: ` +

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_average_stage_age",
      answer,

          source_id: "demo-summary-highest-average-age",

          metric: "average_days_in_stage",
          value: top.average_days_in_stage,
          unit: "days",
        },
      ],
      {

        average_days_in_stage: top.average_days_in_stage,

  const highestValue = normalized.includes("highest") ||

  if (highestValue && (normalized.includes("stage") || normalized.includes("funnel"))) {

        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-product",

      }],
      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },

  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_source",
      `${top.source} has the highest observed total lead value by acquisition source: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{

        `and average age ${format(lost.average_days_in_stage)} days. These are current-stage comparisons, not transition or conversion rates.`;

          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-won",

            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: won.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-lost",
            group: "Lost",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: lost.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
        ],
        {
          won_leads: won.lead_count,
          won_value: won.total_lead_value,

/**
 * Keeps the deterministic answer authoritative.
 * Gemini may explain supported evidence, but may not invent or alter findings.
 */
export async function answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation(
  question: unknown,
): Promise<DemoReply> {
  const reply = answerDemoQuestion(question);

  if (reply.status !== "SUPPORTED") {
    return { ...reply, explanation: null, explanation_status: "SKIPPED" };
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim();

  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_only",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        timeout: 15000,
        retryOptions: { attempts: 1 },
      },
    });
    const prompt = [
      "You are explaining a deterministic answer from a synthetic CRM demonstration dataset.",
      "The deterministic answer and supplied evidence are authoritative. Explain them clearly in 2-4 sentences.",
      "Do not add or calculate numbers, rankings, facts, predictions, causal claims, conversion rates, or seasonality.",
      "Do not contradict or rewrite the deterministic answer.",
      "Mention that the dataset is synthetic where relevant and preserve the stated limitations.",
      "Question: " + String(question),
      "Deterministic answer: " + reply.answer,
      "Approved evidence: " + JSON.stringify(reply.evidence_references),
      "Approved key values: " + JSON.stringify(reply.key_values),
      "Data version: " + reply.metadata.data_version,
      "Method version: " + reply.metadata.method_version,
      "Limitations: " + reply.limitation,
    ].join("\n");

    const result = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || "gemini-3.8-flash",
      contents: prompt,
    });

const explanation = result.text?.trim();

if (!explanation || explanation.length > 2000) {
  throw new Error("Gemini returned an empty or oversized explanation.");
}

const grounding = validateGroundedExplanation(explanation, {
  deterministicAnswer: reply.answer,
  evidenceReferences: reply.evidence_references.map((item) => ({
    group: item.group,
    finding: item.finding,
    value: item.value,
    unit: item.unit,
    data_version: item.data_version,
    method_version: item.method_version,
    limitation: item.limitation,
  })),
  limitation: reply.limitation,
});

if (!grounding.valid) {
  console.warn(
    "[Demo Gemini explanation rejected by grounding validator]",
    grounding.reason,
  );
  throw new Error("Gemini explanation failed grounding validation.");
}


    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation,
      explanation_status: "GENERATED",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_with_gemini_explanation",
        llm_enabled: true,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    const safeMessage = apiKey
      ? message.split(apiKey).join("[REDACTED]")
      : message;
    console.error(
      "[Demo Gemini explanation failure]",
      safeMessage.slice(0, 500),
    );
    // Gemini failure must never remove the validated answer or its evidence.
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_fallback",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }
}
````

````
function createLocalExplanation(reply: DemoReply): DemoReply {

  const candidate = `${reply.answer} ${reply.limitation}`;

  const grounding = validateGroundedExplanation(candidate, {
    deterministicAnswer: reply.answer,
    evidenceReferences: reply.evidence_references.map((item) => ({

      data_version: item.data_version,
      method_version: item.method_version,
      limitation: item.limitation,
    })),
    limitation: reply.limitation,
  });

  const explanation = grounding.valid ? candidate : reply.answer;

  return {
    ...reply,
    explanation,
    explanation_status: "GENERATED",
    metadata: {
      ...reply.metadata,
      mode: "deterministic_fallback",
      llm_enabled: false,
````

````
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {

  }).format(value);
}

function createReply(
  status: ReplyStatus,

    metric?: string;

      "Which product has the highest total lead value?",
      "Compare Won and Lost stages.",
      "What are the limitations?",
    ],
  };
}

export function answerDemoQuestion(question: unknown): DemoReply {
  if (typeof question !== "string" || !question.trim()) {

  }

  const normalized = question.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (

    normalized.includes("conversion rates") ||

    normalized.includes("seasonality") ||
    normalized.includes("causation")
  ) {
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_limitations",
      summary.limitations.join(" "),
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-limitations",
          metric: "limitations",
          finding: summary.limitations.join(" "),
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  if (

    normalized.includes("random seed") ||
    normalized.includes("observation window")
  ) {
    const answer =
      `The dataset version is ${summary.data_version}, generated with seed ${summary.random_seed}. ` +
      `The observation window is ${summary.observation_window.start} to ${summary.observation_window.end}, ` +
      `covering ${summary.observation_window.calendar_months} calendar months.`;

    return createReply(

      answer,

          metric: "data_version",

        observation_end: summary.observation_window.end,
      },
    );
  }

  if (

  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const answer =
      `This synthetic demonstration contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} source leads ` +
      `and ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows. Total observed lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units. Average lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_lead_value)} units. Mean current-stage age is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_days_in_stage)} days and median age is ` +
      `${format(stats.median_days_in_stage)} days. The dataset contains current-stage snapshots, not transition history.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_demo_summary",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "source_leads_analyzed",
          value: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
          unit: "leads",
          finding: `The dataset contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} synthetic source leads.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "canonical_rows_processed",
          value: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
          unit: "rows",
          finding: `The analytical process processed ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "total_lead_value",
          value: stats.total_lead_value,
          unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          finding: `Total observed lead value is ${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units.`,
        },
      ],
      {
        source_leads: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
        canonical_rows: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
        total_lead_value: stats.total_lead_value,
        average_lead_value: stats.average_lead_value,
        mean_days_in_stage: stats.average_days_in_stage,
        median_days_in_stage: stats.median_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const wantsHighestAge =
    normalized.includes("highest average age") ||

  if (wantsHighestAge && normalized.includes("stage")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage;
    const answer =
      `${top.stage} has the highest average recorded age in this synthetic snapshot: ` +
      `${format(top.average_days_in_stage)} days. This does not explain why records remain in that stage.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_average_stage_age",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-highest-average-age",
          group: top.stage,
          metric: "average_days_in_stage",
          value: top.average_days_in_stage,
          unit: "days",
        },
      ],
      {
        stage: top.stage,
        average_days_in_stage: top.average_days_in_stage,

  const highestValue = normalized.includes("highest") ||

  if (highestValue && (normalized.includes("stage") || normalized.includes("funnel"))) {

    return createReply(

        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_source",
      `${top.source} has the highest observed total lead value by acquisition source: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-source",
        group: top.source,

          },
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-lost",
            group: "Lost",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
````

````
export function answerDemoQuestion(question: unknown): DemoReply {
  if (typeof question !== "string" || !question.trim()) {
    return createReply(
      "MISSING_PARAMETER",
      null,
      "Please enter a question about the synthetic demo dataset.",
    );
  }

  if (question.length > 500) {
    return createReply(
      "UNSUPPORTED",
      null,
      "Questions must be 500 characters or fewer.",
    );
  }

  const normalized = question.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (
    normalized.includes("limitation") ||
    normalized.includes("conversion rate") ||
    normalized.includes("conversion rates") ||
    normalized.includes("transition history") ||
    normalized.includes("seasonality") ||
    normalized.includes("causation")
  ) {
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_limitations",
      summary.limitations.join(" "),
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-limitations",
          metric: "limitations",
          finding: summary.limitations.join(" "),
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("version") ||
    normalized.includes("random seed") ||
    normalized.includes("observation window")
  ) {
    const answer =
      `The dataset version is ${summary.data_version}, generated with seed ${summary.random_seed}. ` +
      `The observation window is ${summary.observation_window.start} to ${summary.observation_window.end}, ` +
      `covering ${summary.observation_window.calendar_months} calendar months.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_data_version",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-metadata",
          metric: "data_version",
          finding: answer,
        },
      ],
      {
        data_version: summary.data_version,
        random_seed: summary.random_seed,
        observation_start: summary.observation_window.start,
        observation_end: summary.observation_window.end,
      },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("summary") ||
    normalized.includes("how many leads") ||
    normalized.includes("dataset overview") ||
    normalized.includes("how was the analysis performed")
  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const answer =
      `This synthetic demonstration contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} source leads ` +
      `and ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows. Total observed lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units. Average lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_lead_value)} units. Mean current-stage age is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_days_in_stage)} days and median age is ` +
      `${format(stats.median_days_in_stage)} days. The dataset contains current-stage snapshots, not transition history.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_demo_summary",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "source_leads_analyzed",
          value: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
          unit: "leads",
          finding: `The dataset contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} synthetic source leads.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "canonical_rows_processed",
          value: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
          unit: "rows",
          finding: `The analytical process processed ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "total_lead_value",
          value: stats.total_lead_value,
          unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          finding: `Total observed lead value is ${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units.`,
        },
      ],
      {
        source_leads: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
        canonical_rows: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
        total_lead_value: stats.total_lead_value,
        average_lead_value: stats.average_lead_value,
        mean_days_in_stage: stats.average_days_in_stage,
        median_days_in_stage: stats.median_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const wantsHighestAge =
    normalized.includes("highest average age") ||
    normalized.includes("oldest stage") ||
    normalized.includes("longest");

  if (wantsHighestAge && normalized.includes("stage")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage;
    const answer =
      `${top.stage} has the highest average recorded age in this synthetic snapshot: ` +
      `${format(top.average_days_in_stage)} days. This does not explain why records remain in that stage.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_average_stage_age",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-highest-average-age",
          group: top.stage,
          metric: "average_days_in_stage",
          value: top.average_days_in_stage,
          unit: "days",
        },
      ],
      {
        stage: top.stage,
        average_days_in_stage: top.average_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const highestValue = normalized.includes("highest") ||
    normalized.includes("top") ||
    normalized.includes("most");

  if (highestValue && (normalized.includes("stage") || normalized.includes("funnel"))) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_stage;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_stage",
      `${top.stage} has the highest observed total lead value by stage: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-stage",
        group: top.stage,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { stage: top.stage, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (highestValue && normalized.includes("product")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_product;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_product",
      `${top.product} has the highest observed total lead value by product: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-product",
        group: top.product,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_source",
      `${top.source} has the highest observed total lead value by acquisition source: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-source",
        group: top.source,
        metric: "total_lead_value",
        value: top.total_lead_value,
        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { source: top.source, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("compare won and lost") ||
    (normalized.includes("won") && normalized.includes("lost"))
  ) {
    const won = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Won");
    const lost = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Lost");

    if (won && lost) {
      const answer =
        `In the current snapshot, Won contains ${won.lead_count} leads with total observed value ` +
        `${format(won.total_lead_value)} units and average age ${format(won.average_days_in_stage)} days. ` +
        `Lost contains ${lost.lead_count} leads with total observed value ${format(lost.total_lead_value)} units ` +
        `and average age ${format(lost.average_days_in_stage)} days. These are current-stage comparisons, not transition or conversion rates.`;

      return createReply(
        "SUPPORTED",
        "compare_won_lost",
        answer,
        [
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-won",
            group: "Won",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: won.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-lost",
            group: "Lost",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: lost.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
        ],
        {
          won_leads: won.lead_count,
          won_value: won.total_lead_value,
          won_average_age_days: won.average_days_in_stage,
          lost_leads: lost.lead_count,
          lost_value: lost.total_lead_value,
          lost_average_age_days: lost.average_days_in_stage,
        },
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("average age") ||
    normalized.includes("mean age") ||
    normalized.includes("average days") ||
    normalized.includes("median age")
  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const useMedian = normalized.includes("median");
    const value = useMedian
      ? stats.median_days_in_stage
      : stats.average_days_in_stage;
    const metric = useMedian ? "median_days_in_stage" : "average_days_in_stage";

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_average_stage_age",
      `The ${useMedian ? "median" : "mean"} recorded age across current-stage records is ${format(value)} days in the synthetic demo dataset.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-overall-age",
        metric,
        value,
        unit: "days",
      }],
      { [metric]: value },
    );
  }

  return createReply(
    "UNSUPPORTED",
    null,
    "I can answer questions grounded in this demo's summary, highest-value stage/product/source, current-stage age, Won-versus-Lost snapshot comparison, dataset version, and limitations. I cannot infer historical transitions, real conversion rates, causes, seasonality, or future outcomes.",
  );
}


/**
 * Keeps the deterministic answer authoritative.
 * Gemini may explain supported evidence, but may not invent or alter findings.
 */
export async function answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation(
  question: unknown,
): Promise<DemoReply> {
  const reply = answerDemoQuestion(question);

  if (reply.status !== "SUPPORTED") {
    return { ...reply, explanation: null, explanation_status: "SKIPPED" };
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim();

  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_only",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        timeout: 30000,
        retryOptions: {
          attempts: 1,
          initialDelay: 1,
          maxDelay: 3,
        },
      },
    });
    const prompt = [
      "You are explaining a deterministic answer from a synthetic CRM demonstration dataset.",
      "The deterministic answer and supplied evidence are authoritative. Explain them clearly in 2-4 sentences.",
      "Do not add or calculate numbers, rankings, facts, predictions, causal claims, conversion rates, or seasonality.",
      "Do not contradict or rewrite the deterministic answer.",
      "Mention that the dataset is synthetic where relevant and preserve the stated limitations.",
      "Question: " + String(question),
      "Deterministic answer: " + reply.answer,
      "Approved evidence: " + JSON.stringify(reply.evidence_references),
      "Approved key values: " + JSON.stringify(reply.key_values),
      "Data version: " + reply.metadata.data_version,
      "Method version: " + reply.metadata.method_version,
      "Limitations: " + reply.limitation,
    ].join("\n");

    const result = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || "gemini-3.8-flash",
      contents: prompt,
    });

const explanation = result.text?.trim();

if (!explanation || explanation.length > 2000) {
  throw new Error("Gemini returned an empty or oversized explanation.");
}

const grounding = validateGroundedExplanation(explanation, {
  deterministicAnswer: reply.answer,
  evidenceReferences: reply.evidence_references.map((item) => ({
    group: item.group,
    finding: item.finding,
    value: item.value,
    unit: item.unit,
    data_version: item.data_version,
    method_version: item.method_version,
    limitation: item.limitation,
  })),
  limitation: reply.limitation,
});

if (!grounding.valid) {
  console.warn(
    "[Demo Gemini explanation rejected by grounding validator]",
    grounding.reason,
  );
  throw new Error("Gemini explanation failed grounding validation.");
}


    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation,
      explanation_status: "GENERATED",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_with_gemini_explanation",
        llm_enabled: true,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    const safeMessage = apiKey
      ? message.split(apiKey).join("[REDACTED]")
      : message;
    console.error(
      "[Demo Gemini explanation failure]",
      safeMessage.slice(0, 500),
    );
    // Gemini failure must never remove the validated answer or its evidence.
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_fallback",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }
}
````

````
        group: top.product,

        unit: "currency-unspecified units",
      }],
      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_value_source",
      `${top.source} has the highest observed total lead value by acquisition source: ${format(top.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units in this synthetic sample.`,
      [{
        source_id: "demo-summary-highest-value-source",
        group: top.source,
        metric: "total_lead_value",

    );

    normalized.includes("compare won and lost") ||
    (normalized.includes("won") && normalized.includes("lost"))
  ) {
    const won = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Won");
    const lost = summary.dimensions.stage.find((row) => row.stage === "Lost");

    if (won && lost) {
      const answer =
        `In the current snapshot, Won contains ${won.lead_count} leads with total observed value ` +
        `${format(won.total_lead_value)} units and average age ${format(won.average_days_in_stage)} days. ` +
        `Lost contains ${lost.lead_count} leads with total observed value ${format(lost.total_lead_value)} units ` +
        `and average age ${format(lost.average_days_in_stage)} days. These are current-stage comparisons, not transition or conversion rates.`;

      return createReply(
        "SUPPORTED",
        "compare_won_lost",
        answer,
        [
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-won",
            group: "Won",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: won.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
          {
            source_id: "demo-stage-lost",
            group: "Lost",
            metric: "total_lead_value",
            value: lost.total_lead_value,
            unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          },
        ],

  }

    "UNSUPPORTED",
    null,
    "I can answer questions grounded in this demo's summary, highest-value stage/product/source, current-stage age, Won-versus-Lost snapshot comparison, dataset version, and limitations. I cannot infer historical transitions, real conversion rates, causes, seasonality, or future outcomes.",

/**
 * Keeps the deterministic answer authoritative.
 * Gemini may explain supported evidence, but may not invent or alter findings.
 */
export async function answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation(
  question: unknown,
): Promise<DemoReply> {
  const reply = answerDemoQuestion(question);

  if (reply.status !== "SUPPORTED") {
    return { ...reply, explanation: null, explanation_status: "SKIPPED" };
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim();

  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_only",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        timeout: 30000,
        retryOptions: {
          attempts: 2,
          initialDelay: 1,
          maxDelay: 3,
        },
      },
    });
    const prompt = [
      "You are explaining a deterministic answer from a synthetic CRM demonstration dataset.",
      "The deterministic answer and supplied evidence are authoritative. Explain them clearly in 2-4 sentences.",
      "Do not add or calculate numbers, rankings, facts, predictions, causal claims, conversion rates, or seasonality.",
      "Do not contradict or rewrite the deterministic answer.",
      "Mention that the dataset is synthetic where relevant and preserve the stated limitations.",
      "Question: " + String(question),
      "Deterministic answer: " + reply.answer,
      "Approved evidence: " + JSON.stringify(reply.evidence_references),
      "Approved key values: " + JSON.stringify(reply.key_values),
      "Data version: " + reply.metadata.data_version,
      "Method version: " + reply.metadata.method_version,
      "Limitations: " + reply.limitation,
    ].join("\n");

    const result = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || "gemini-3.8-flash",
      contents: prompt,
    });

const explanation = result.text?.trim();

if (!explanation || explanation.length > 2000) {
  throw new Error("Gemini returned an empty or oversized explanation.");
}

const grounding = validateGroundedExplanation(explanation, {
  deterministicAnswer: reply.answer,
  evidenceReferences: reply.evidence_references.map((item) => ({
    group: item.group,
    finding: item.finding,
    value: item.value,
    unit: item.unit,
    data_version: item.data_version,
    method_version: item.method_version,
    limitation: item.limitation,
  })),
  limitation: reply.limitation,
});

if (!grounding.valid) {
  console.warn(
    "[Demo Gemini explanation rejected by grounding validator]",
    grounding.reason,
  );
  throw new Error("Gemini explanation failed grounding validation.");
}


    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation,
      explanation_status: "GENERATED",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_with_gemini_explanation",
        llm_enabled: true,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    const safeMessage = apiKey
      ? message.split(apiKey).join("[REDACTED]")
      : message;
    console.error(
      "[Demo Gemini explanation failure]",
      safeMessage.slice(0, 500),
    );
    // Gemini failure must never remove the validated answer or its evidence.
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_fallback",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }
}
````

````
    group: item.group,
    finding: item.finding,
    value: item.value,
    unit: item.unit,
    data_version: item.data_version,
    method_version: item.method_version,
    limitation: item.limitation,
  })),
  limitation: reply.limitation,
});

if (!grounding.valid) {
  console.warn(
    "[Demo Gemini explanation rejected by grounding validator]",
    grounding.reason,
  );
  throw new Error("Gemini explanation failed grounding validation.");
}


    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation,
      explanation_status: "GENERATED",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_with_gemini_explanation",
        llm_enabled: true,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[Demo Gemini explanation failure]");
    // Gemini failure must never remove the validated answer or its evidence.
    return createLocalExplanation(reply);
  }
}
````

````
import { validateGroundedExplanation } from "./explanation-grounding";
import rawSummary from "../../data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/analytics/intelligence_summary.json";
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

type MetricRow = {
  stage?: string;
  product?: string;
  source?: string;
  team?: string;
  location?: string;
  lead_count: number;
  total_lead_value: number;
  average_lead_value: number;
  average_days_in_stage: number;
  median_days_in_stage: number;
  value_share_percent: number;
};

type DemoSummary = {
  project: string;
  dataset_classification: string;
  data_version: string;
  random_seed: number;
  observation_window: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    calendar_months: number;
  };
  overall_summary: {
    source_leads_analyzed: number;
    canonical_rows_processed: number;
    total_lead_value: number;
    average_lead_value: number;
    average_days_in_stage: number;
    median_days_in_stage: number;
  };
  highest_observed_groups: {
    highest_value_stage: { stage: string; total_lead_value: number };
    highest_value_product: { product: string; total_lead_value: number };
    highest_value_source: { source: string; total_lead_value: number };
    highest_average_age_stage: {
      stage: string;
      average_days_in_stage: number;
    };
  };
  dimensions: {
    stage: MetricRow[];
    product: MetricRow[];
    source: MetricRow[];
    team: MetricRow[];
    location: MetricRow[];
  };
  interpretation: string[];
  limitations: string[];
};

type Evidence = {
  source_id: string;
  source_type: string;
  group?: string;
  metric?: string;
  value?: number;
  unit?: string;
  finding: string;
  data_version: string;
  method_version: string;
  generated_at: string;
  quality_status: string;
  limitation: string;
};

type ReplyStatus = "SUPPORTED" | "UNSUPPORTED" | "MISSING_PARAMETER";

type DemoReply = {
  answer_id: string;
  status: ReplyStatus;
  intent: string | null;
  answer: string;
  explanation: string | null;
  explanation_status: "GENERATED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "SKIPPED";
  evidence_references: Evidence[];
  key_values: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>;
  metadata: {
    assistant_id: string;
    assistant_version: string;
    mode: string;
    llm_enabled: boolean;
    data_version: string;
    method_version: string;
    quality_status: string;
    generated_at: string;
  };
  limitation: string;
  suggested_follow_ups: string[];
};

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;
const METHOD_VERSION = "demo-assistant-rules-1.0.0";
const QUALITY_STATUS = "SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DESCRIPTIVE";

const LIMITATION =
  "All figures come from synthetic demonstration data. Results are descriptive, use currency-unspecified units, and do not establish causation, real-world outcomes, stage transitions, conversion rates, or seasonality.";

function format(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

function createReply(
  status: ReplyStatus,
  intent: string | null,
  answer: string,
  evidence: Array<{
    source_id: string;
    group?: string;
    metric?: string;
    value?: number;
    unit?: string;
    finding?: string;
  }> = [],
  keyValues: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> = {},
): DemoReply {
  const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    answer_id: `demo-assistant-${Date.now()}`,
    status,
    intent,
    answer,
    explanation: null,
    explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
    evidence_references: evidence.map((item) => ({
      source_id: item.source_id,
      source_type: "demo_intelligence_summary",
      ...(item.group !== undefined ? { group: item.group } : {}),
      ...(item.metric !== undefined ? { metric: item.metric } : {}),
      ...(item.value !== undefined ? { value: item.value } : {}),
      ...(item.unit !== undefined ? { unit: item.unit } : {}),
      finding: item.finding ?? answer,
      data_version: summary.data_version,
      method_version: METHOD_VERSION,
      generated_at: generatedAt,
      quality_status: QUALITY_STATUS,
      limitation: LIMITATION,
    })),
    key_values: keyValues,
    metadata: {
      assistant_id: "phase3-demo-grounded-assistant",
      assistant_version: "1.0.0",

    },
    limitation: LIMITATION,
    suggested_follow_ups: [
      "Which stage has the highest total lead value?",
      "Which product has the highest total lead value?",
      "Compare Won and Lost stages.",
      "What are the limitations?",
    ],
  };
}

export function answerDemoQuestion(question: unknown): DemoReply {
  if (typeof question !== "string" || !question.trim()) {
    return createReply(
      "MISSING_PARAMETER",

  if (question.length > 500) {

  const normalized = question.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (
    normalized.includes("limitation") ||

    normalized.includes("conversion rates") ||
    normalized.includes("transition history") ||
    normalized.includes("seasonality") ||
    normalized.includes("causation")
  ) {
    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_limitations",
      summary.limitations.join(" "),
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-limitations",
          metric: "limitations",
          finding: summary.limitations.join(" "),
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  if (

    normalized.includes("random seed") ||
    normalized.includes("observation window")
  ) {

      `The dataset version is ${summary.data_version}, generated with seed ${summary.random_seed}. ` +
      `The observation window is ${summary.observation_window.start} to ${summary.observation_window.end}, ` +
      `covering ${summary.observation_window.calendar_months} calendar months.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_data_version",
      answer,
      [
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-metadata",
          metric: "data_version",
          finding: answer,
        },
      ],
      {
        data_version: summary.data_version,
        random_seed: summary.random_seed,
        observation_start: summary.observation_window.start,
        observation_end: summary.observation_window.end,
      },
    );
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("summary") ||
    normalized.includes("how many leads") ||
    normalized.includes("dataset overview") ||
    normalized.includes("how was the analysis performed")
  ) {
    const stats = summary.overall_summary;
    const answer =
      `This synthetic demonstration contains ${format(stats.source_leads_analyzed)} source leads ` +
      `and ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows. Total observed lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units. Average lead value is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_lead_value)} units. Mean current-stage age is ` +
      `${format(stats.average_days_in_stage)} days and median age is ` +
      `${format(stats.median_days_in_stage)} days. The dataset contains current-stage snapshots, not transition history.`;

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_demo_summary",
      answer,

        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "source_leads_analyzed",
          value: stats.source_leads_analyzed,

        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "canonical_rows_processed",
          value: stats.canonical_rows_processed,
          unit: "rows",
          finding: `The analytical process processed ${format(stats.canonical_rows_processed)} canonical rows.`,
        },
        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-overall",
          metric: "total_lead_value",
          value: stats.total_lead_value,
          unit: "currency-unspecified units",
          finding: `Total observed lead value is ${format(stats.total_lead_value)} currency-unspecified units.`,

      ],

        source_leads: stats.source_leads_analyzed,
        canonical_rows: stats.canonical_rows_processed,

        average_lead_value: stats.average_lead_value,
        mean_days_in_stage: stats.average_days_in_stage,
        median_days_in_stage: stats.median_days_in_stage,
      },
    );
  }

  const wantsHighestAge =
    normalized.includes("highest average age") ||

  if (wantsHighestAge && normalized.includes("stage")) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage;
    const answer =
      `${top.stage} has the highest average recorded age in this synthetic snapshot: ` +

    return createReply(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_highest_average_stage_age",

        {
          source_id: "demo-summary-highest-average-age",

      { product: top.product, total_lead_value: top.total_lead_value },
    );
  }

  if (
    highestValue &&
    (normalized.includes("source") || normalized.includes("acquisition"))
  ) {
    const top = summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source;
    return createReply(

      "get_highest_value_source",

    const value = useMedian

      [{

  }

  return createReply(

  );
}


/**
 * Keeps the deterministic answer authoritative.
 * Gemini may explain supported evidence, but may not invent or alter findings.
 */
export async function answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation(
  question: unknown,
): Promise<DemoReply> {
  const reply = answerDemoQuestion(question);

  if (reply.status !== "SUPPORTED") {
    return { ...reply, explanation: null, explanation_status: "SKIPPED" };
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim();

  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_only",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        timeout: 15000,
        retryOptions: { attempts: 1 },
      },
    });
    const prompt = [
      "You are explaining a deterministic answer from a synthetic CRM demonstration dataset.",
      "The deterministic answer and supplied evidence are authoritative. Explain them clearly in 2-4 sentences.",
      "Do not add or calculate numbers, rankings, facts, predictions, causal claims, conversion rates, or seasonality.",
      "Do not contradict or rewrite the deterministic answer.",
      "Mention that the dataset is synthetic where relevant and preserve the stated limitations.",
      "Question: " + String(question),
      "Deterministic answer: " + reply.answer,
      "Approved evidence: " + JSON.stringify(reply.evidence_references),
      "Approved key values: " + JSON.stringify(reply.key_values),
      "Data version: " + reply.metadata.data_version,
      "Method version: " + reply.metadata.method_version,
      "Limitations: " + reply.limitation,
    ].join("\n");

    const result = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || "gemini-3.8-flash",
      contents: prompt,
    });

const explanation = result.text?.trim();

if (!explanation || explanation.length > 2000) {
  throw new Error("Gemini returned an empty or oversized explanation.");
}

const grounding = validateGroundedExplanation(explanation, {
  deterministicAnswer: reply.answer,
  evidenceReferences: reply.evidence_references.map((item) => ({
    group: item.group,
    finding: item.finding,
    value: item.value,
    unit: item.unit,
    data_version: item.data_version,
    method_version: item.method_version,
    limitation: item.limitation,
  })),
  limitation: reply.limitation,
});

if (!grounding.valid) {
  console.warn(
    "[Demo Gemini explanation rejected by grounding validator]",
    grounding.reason,
  );
  throw new Error("Gemini explanation failed grounding validation.");
}


    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation,
      explanation_status: "GENERATED",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_with_gemini_explanation",
        llm_enabled: true,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    // Gemini failure must never remove the validated answer or its evidence.
    return {
      ...reply,
      explanation: null,
      explanation_status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      metadata: {
        ...reply.metadata,
        mode: "deterministic_fallback",
        llm_enabled: false,
      },
    };
  }
}
````
