## File: src/app/demo/data-intelligence/page.tsx.backup-before-lint-fix
````
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import rawSummary from "../../../../data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/analytics/intelligence_summary.json";
import { demoCrmData } from "@/data/demoCrmData";
import DemoDataAssistant from "@/components/DemoDataAssistant";

type MetricRow = {
  stage?: string;
  product?: string;
  source?: string;
  team?: string;
  location?: string;
  lead_count: number;
  total_lead_value: number;
  average_lead_value: number;
  average_days_in_stage: number;
  median_days_in_stage: number;
  value_share_percent: number;
};

type DimensionKey = "stage" | "product" | "source" | "team" | "location";

type DemoSummary = {
  project: string;
  dataset_classification: string;
  data_version: string;
  random_seed: number;
  observation_window: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    calendar_months: number;
  };
  overall_summary: {
    source_leads_analyzed: number;
    canonical_rows_processed: number;
    total_lead_value: number;
    average_lead_value: number;
    average_days_in_stage: number;
    median_days_in_stage: number;
  };
  highest_observed_groups: {
    highest_value_stage: {
      stage: string;
      total_lead_value: number;
    };
    highest_value_product: {
      product: string;
      total_lead_value: number;
    };
    highest_value_source: {
      source: string;
      total_lead_value: number;
    };
    highest_average_age_stage: {
      stage: string;
      average_days_in_stage: number;
    };
  };
  dimensions: Record<DimensionKey, MetricRow[]>;
  interpretation: string[];
  limitations: string[];
};

type DemoLead = (typeof demoCrmData)[number];

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;

const fmt = (n: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(n);

const dimensions: {
  key: DimensionKey;
  label: string;
  field: DimensionKey;
}[] = [
  { key: "stage", label: "Stage", field: "stage" },
  { key: "product", label: "Product", field: "product" },
  { key: "source", label: "Acquisition source", field: "source" },
  { key: "team", label: "Team", field: "team" },
  { key: "location", label: "Location", field: "location" },
];

const metricOptions = [
  { key: "lead_count", label: "Lead count", unit: "leads" },
  {
    key: "total_lead_value",
    label: "Total observed value",
    unit: "unspecified units",
  },
  {
    key: "average_lead_value",
    label: "Average lead value",
    unit: "unspecified units / lead",
  },
  {
    key: "average_days_in_stage",
    label: "Mean days in current stage",
    unit: "days",
  },
] as const;

type MetricKey = (typeof metricOptions)[number]["key"];

type Finding = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  dimension: DimensionKey;
  group: string;
  summary: string;
  review: string;
  metric: MetricKey;
};

function groupValue(row: MetricRow, key: DimensionKey) {
  return String(row[key] ?? "Unknown");
}

function getRows(key: DimensionKey) {
  return summary.dimensions[key] ?? [];
}

function rowMetric(row: MetricRow, key: MetricKey) {
  return row[key];
}

export default function DemoDataIntelligencePage() {
  const [dimension, setDimension] = useState<DimensionKey>("stage");
  const [metric, setMetric] =
    useState<MetricKey>("total_lead_value");
  const [selectedGroup, setSelectedGroup] = useState("Opportunity");
  const [showRecords, setShowRecords] = useState(true);
  const [showMethodology, setShowMethodology] = useState(false);
  const [ageSort, setAgeSort] = useState<"desc" | "asc">("desc");
  const [recordQuery, setRecordQuery] = useState("");

  const findings: Finding[] = useMemo(() => {
    const stageValue =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_stage.stage;
    const productValue =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_product.product;
    const sourceValue =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source.source;
    const ageStage =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage.stage;

    const stageRow = getRows("stage").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "stage") === stageValue
    );
    const productRow = getRows("product").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "product") === productValue
    );
    const sourceRow = getRows("source").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "source") === sourceValue
    );
    const ageRow = getRows("stage").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "stage") === ageStage
    );

    return [
      {
        id: "stage-value",
        title: `${stageValue} has the highest observed stage value`,
        dimension: "stage",
        group: stageValue,
        summary: `${fmt(stageRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          stageRow?.total_lead_value ?? 0
        )} observed value`,
        review:
          "Compare the contributing records and current-stage ages; this is descriptive, not causal.",
        metric: "total_lead_value",
      },
      {
        id: "product-value",
        title: `${productValue} has the highest observed product value`,
        dimension: "product",
        group: productValue,
        summary: `${fmt(productRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          productRow?.value_share_percent ?? 0
        )}% of observed value`,
        review:
          "Compare lead count and average value before interpreting the concentration.",
        metric: "total_lead_value",
      },
      {
        id: "source-value",
        title: `${sourceValue} has the highest observed source value`,
        dimension: "source",
        group: sourceValue,
        summary: `${fmt(sourceRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          sourceRow?.value_share_percent ?? 0
        )}% of observed value`,
        review:
          "Compare other source groups and their per-lead averages; no attribution is established.",
        metric: "total_lead_value",
      },
      {
        id: "stage-aging",
        title: `${ageStage} has the highest mean recorded stage age`,
        dimension: "stage",
        group: ageStage,
        summary: `${fmt(ageRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          ageRow?.average_days_in_stage ?? 0
        )} days mean age`,
        review:
          "Review older records in this snapshot; this does not establish why records were lost or delayed.",
        metric: "average_days_in_stage",
      },
    ];
  }, []);

  const activeRows = getRows(dimension)
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => rowMetric(b, metric) - rowMetric(a, metric));

  const selectedRow =
    activeRows.find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, dimension) === selectedGroup
    ) ?? activeRows[0];

  const maxMetric = Math.max(
    1,
    ...activeRows.map((r) => rowMetric(r, metric))
  );

  const activeMetric = metricOptions.find(
    (m) => m.key === metric
  )!;

  const scopedRecords = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedRow) return [] as DemoLead[];

    return demoCrmData
      .filter(
        (lead) =>
          String(lead[dimension]) ===
          groupValue(selectedRow, dimension)
      )
      .filter((lead) =>
        [
          lead.id,
          lead.product,
          lead.source,
          lead.team,
          lead.location,
          lead.stage,
        ]
          .join(" ")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(recordQuery.toLowerCase())
      )
      .sort((a, b) =>
        ageSort === "desc"
          ? b.daysInStage - a.daysInStage
          : a.daysInStage - b.daysInStage
      );
  }, [
    dimension,
    selectedGroup,
    recordQuery,
    ageSort,
    selectedRow,
  ]);

  function chooseFinding(f: Finding) {
    setDimension(f.dimension);
    setSelectedGroup(f.group);
    setMetric(f.metric);
    setShowRecords(true);
  }

  function chooseDimension(key: DimensionKey) {
    setDimension(key);
    const firstRow = getRows(key)[0];

    if (firstRow) {
      setSelectedGroup(groupValue(firstRow, key));
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#F4F7FB] px-4 py-5 text-[#172339] sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1440px] space-y-5">
        <header className="rounded-2xl bg-[#142641] px-5 py-4 text-white shadow-sm sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-blue-200">
                Infocreon | Synthetic demonstration
              </p>
              <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl">
                Lead Intelligence
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-200">
                Explore observed patterns, inspect evidence, and decide
                what to investigate next.
              </p>
            </div>

            <nav
              aria-label="Demo navigation"
              className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"
            >
              <Link
                href="/demo"
                className="rounded-lg border border-white/25 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/10"
              >
                Operational dashboard
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/demo/data-intelligence"
                aria-current="page"
                className="rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-[#142641]"
              >
                Lead Intelligence
              </Link>
            </nav>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1 border-t border-white/15 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-200">
            <span>
              Data version:{" "}
              <strong className="text-white">
                {summary.data_version}
              </strong>
            </span>
            <span>
              Seed:{" "}
              <strong className="text-white">
                {summary.random_seed}
              </strong>
            </span>
            <span>
              Window:{" "}
              <strong className="text-white">
                {summary.observation_window.start} -{" "}
                {summary.observation_window.end}
              </strong>
            </span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-amber-200">
              Synthetic data - not real customer outcomes
            </span>
          </div>
        </header>

        <section
          aria-label="Dataset summary"

        >

            [

            ],
            [

            [

        <footer className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2 border-t border-[#DFE6F0] py-4 text-xs text-[#52647B]">
          <span>
            {summary.project} | {summary.data_version} | Method version 1.0.0
          </span>
          <span>
            Descriptive synthetic snapshot | no prediction or causal claims
          </span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
````

````
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import rawSummary from "../../../../data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/analytics/intelligence_summary.json";
import { demoCrmData } from "@/data/demoCrmData";
import DemoDataAssistant from "@/components/DemoDataAssistant";

type MetricRow = {
  stage?: string;
  product?: string;
  source?: string;
  team?: string;
  location?: string;
  lead_count: number;
  total_lead_value: number;
  average_lead_value: number;
  average_days_in_stage: number;
  median_days_in_stage: number;
  value_share_percent: number;
};

type DimensionKey = "stage" | "product" | "source" | "team" | "location";

type DemoSummary = {
  project: string;
  dataset_classification: string;
  data_version: string;
  random_seed: number;
  observation_window: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    calendar_months: number;
  };
  overall_summary: {
    source_leads_analyzed: number;
    canonical_rows_processed: number;
    total_lead_value: number;
    average_lead_value: number;
    average_days_in_stage: number;
    median_days_in_stage: number;
  };
  highest_observed_groups: {
    highest_value_stage: {
      stage: string;
      total_lead_value: number;
    };
    highest_value_product: {
      product: string;
      total_lead_value: number;
    };
    highest_value_source: {
      source: string;
      total_lead_value: number;
    };
    highest_average_age_stage: {
      stage: string;
      average_days_in_stage: number;
    };
  };
  dimensions: Record<DimensionKey, MetricRow[]>;
  interpretation: string[];
  limitations: string[];
};

type DemoLead = (typeof demoCrmData)[number];

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;

const fmt = (n: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(n);

const dimensions: {
  key: DimensionKey;
  label: string;
  field: DimensionKey;
}[] = [
  { key: "stage", label: "Stage", field: "stage" },
  { key: "product", label: "Product", field: "product" },
  { key: "source", label: "Acquisition source", field: "source" },
  { key: "team", label: "Team", field: "team" },
  { key: "location", label: "Location", field: "location" },
];

const metricOptions = [
  { key: "lead_count", label: "Lead count", unit: "leads" },
  {
    key: "total_lead_value",
    label: "Total observed value",
    unit: "unspecified units",
  },
  {
    key: "average_lead_value",
    label: "Average lead value",
    unit: "unspecified units / lead",
  },
  {
    key: "average_days_in_stage",
    label: "Mean days in current stage",
    unit: "days",
  },
] as const;

type MetricKey = (typeof metricOptions)[number]["key"];

type Finding = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  dimension: DimensionKey;
  group: string;
  summary: string;
  review: string;
  metric: MetricKey;
};

function groupValue(row: MetricRow, key: DimensionKey) {
  return String(row[key] ?? "Unknown");
}

function getRows(key: DimensionKey) {
  return summary.dimensions[key] ?? [];
}

function rowMetric(row: MetricRow, key: MetricKey) {
  return row[key];
}

export default function DemoDataIntelligencePage() {
  const [dimension, setDimension] = useState<DimensionKey>("stage");
  const [metric, setMetric] =
    useState<MetricKey>("total_lead_value");
  const [selectedGroup, setSelectedGroup] = useState("Opportunity");
  const [showRecords, setShowRecords] = useState(true);
  const [showMethodology, setShowMethodology] = useState(false);
  const [ageSort, setAgeSort] = useState<"desc" | "asc">("desc");
  const [recordQuery, setRecordQuery] = useState("");

  const findings: Finding[] = useMemo(() => {
    const stageValue =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_stage.stage;
    const productValue =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_product.product;
    const sourceValue =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_value_source.source;
    const ageStage =
      summary.highest_observed_groups.highest_average_age_stage.stage;

    const stageRow = getRows("stage").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "stage") === stageValue
    );
    const productRow = getRows("product").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "product") === productValue
    );
    const sourceRow = getRows("source").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "source") === sourceValue
    );
    const ageRow = getRows("stage").find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, "stage") === ageStage
    );

    return [
      {
        id: "stage-value",
        title: `${stageValue} has the highest observed stage value`,
        dimension: "stage",
        group: stageValue,
        summary: `${fmt(stageRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          stageRow?.total_lead_value ?? 0
        )} observed value`,
        review:
          "Compare the contributing records and current-stage ages; this is descriptive, not causal.",
        metric: "total_lead_value",
      },
      {
        id: "product-value",
        title: `${productValue} has the highest observed product value`,
        dimension: "product",
        group: productValue,
        summary: `${fmt(productRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          productRow?.value_share_percent ?? 0
        )}% of observed value`,
        review:
          "Compare lead count and average value before interpreting the concentration.",
        metric: "total_lead_value",
      },
      {
        id: "source-value",
        title: `${sourceValue} has the highest observed source value`,
        dimension: "source",

        )}% of observed value`,
        review:
          "Compare other source groups and their per-lead averages; no attribution is established.",
        metric: "total_lead_value",
      },
      {
        id: "stage-aging",
        title: `${ageStage} has the highest mean recorded stage age`,
        dimension: "stage",
        group: ageStage,
        summary: `${fmt(ageRow?.lead_count ?? 0)} leads | ${fmt(
          ageRow?.average_days_in_stage ?? 0
        )} days mean age`,
        review:
          "Review older records in this snapshot; this does not establish why records were lost or delayed.",
        metric: "average_days_in_stage",
      },
    ];
  }, []);

  const activeRows = getRows(dimension)
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => rowMetric(b, metric) - rowMetric(a, metric));

  const selectedRow =
    activeRows.find(
      (r) => groupValue(r, dimension) === selectedGroup
    ) ?? activeRows[0];

  const maxMetric = Math.max(
    1,
    ...activeRows.map((r) => rowMetric(r, metric))
  );

  const activeMetric = metricOptions.find(
    (m) => m.key === metric
  )!;

  const scopedRecords = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedRow) return [] as DemoLead[];

      .filter(
        (lead) =>

      )

      )

      );
  }, [

    recordQuery,
    ageSort,
    selectedRow,
  ]);

  function chooseFinding(f: Finding) {
    setDimension(f.dimension);
    setSelectedGroup(f.group);
    setMetric(f.metric);
    setShowRecords(true);
  }

  function chooseDimension(key: DimensionKey) {

    const firstRow = getRows(key)[0];

    if (firstRow) {
      setSelectedGroup(groupValue(firstRow, key));
    }
  }

  return (

              </h1>
````

````
import rawSummary from "../../../../data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/analytics/intelligence_summary.json";

  source?: string;
  team?: string;
  location?: string;
  lead_count: number;
  total_lead_value: number;
  average_lead_value: number;
  average_days_in_stage: number;
  median_days_in_stage: number;
  value_share_percent: number;
};

type DemoSummary = {

  highest_observed_groups: {

    highest_average_age_stage: {
      stage: string;
      average_days_in_stage: number;
    };
  };
  dimensions: {
    stage: MetricRow[];
    product: MetricRow[];
    source: MetricRow[];
    team: MetricRow[];
    location: MetricRow[];
  };
  interpretation: string[];
  limitations: string[];
};

const summary = rawSummary as DemoSummary;

}

      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-white/45">{detail}</p>

  );
}
````

````
select {
  font: inherit;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

select option {
  background: #0b0f1d;
  color: #ffffff;
}

::selection {
  background: rgba(124, 140, 255, 0.35);
  color: #ffffff;
}

/* Cinematic scrollbar */

::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}

/* Observatory glow */

.observatory-glow {
  position: relative;
}

.observatory-glow::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 50% 0%,
      rgba(124, 140, 255, 0.08),
      transparent 55%
    );
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Glass panel */

.glass-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--panel-soft);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

/* Subtle entrance animation */

.cinematic-enter {
  animation: cinematic-enter 500ms ease-out both;
}

@keyframes cinematic-enter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

/* PHASE3_UIUX_READABILITY_OVERRIDES */
/* Scoped to the synthetic demo dashboard; the production/operational routes stay unchanged. */
[data-demo-ui="true"] {
  --demo-ink: #172b4d;
  --demo-muted: #52627a;
  --demo-subtle: #5d6b80;
  --demo-border: #d9e1ec;
  --demo-surface: #ffffff;
  --demo-surface-soft: #f7f9fc;
  --demo-accent: #2457c5;
  color: var(--demo-ink);
  color-scheme: light;
  background: #f4f7fb;
  border-radius: 0;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] section,
[data-demo-ui="true"] article {
  border-color: var(--demo-border) !important;
  background-color: var(--demo-surface) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 5%) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] h1,
[data-demo-ui="true"] h2,
[data-demo-ui="true"] h3,
[data-demo-ui="true"] h4 {

}

[data-demo-ui="true"] p,

[data-demo-ui="true"] label,
[data-demo-ui="true"] th,
[data-demo-ui="true"] td,

}

[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/90,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/80,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/75,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/70,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/65,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/60,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/55,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/50,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/45,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/40,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/35,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/30,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/25,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-white\/20 {
  color: var(--demo-muted) !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-indigo-300,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-indigo-200,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .text-indigo-300\/50 {
  color: var(--demo-accent) !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/10,
[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/\[0\.08\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/\[0\.06\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/\[0\.07\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/\[0\.05\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/\[0\.04\] {
  border-color: var(--demo-border) !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] .bg-white\/\[0\.025\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .bg-white\/\[0\.02\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .bg-white\/\[0\.035\],
[data-demo-ui="true"] .bg-white\/\[0\.03\] {
  background-color: var(--demo-surface) !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] input,
[data-demo-ui="true"] select,
[data-demo-ui="true"] textarea {
  min-height: 42px;
  border: 1px solid #bdc9d9 !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  color: #172b4d !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] input::placeholder,
[data-demo-ui="true"] textarea::placeholder {
  color: #68788f !important;
  opacity: 1;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] button,
[data-demo-ui="true"] a {
  transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] button:focus-visible,
[data-demo-ui="true"] a:focus-visible,
[data-demo-ui="true"] input:focus-visible,
[data-demo-ui="true"] select:focus-visible,
[data-demo-ui="true"] textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #80a7ff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] footer,
[data-demo-ui="true"] [class*="text-[10px]"],
[data-demo-ui="true"] [class*="text-xs"] {
  color: #52627a;
}

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  [data-demo-ui="true"] {
    padding-left: 12px;
    padding-right: 12px;
  }

  [data-demo-ui="true"] section {
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-demo-ui="true"] *,
  [data-demo-ui="true"] *::before,
  [data-demo-ui="true"] *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}
````

## File: tests/demo-assistant-grounding-test.ts
````typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation } from "../assistant/core/demo-assistant-service";

async function main() {
  const originalKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  delete process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;

  try {
    const result = await answerDemoQuestionWithExplanation(
      "Which stage has the highest total lead value?"
    );

    assert.equal(result.status, "SUPPORTED");
    assert.match(result.answer, /Opportunity/i);
    assert.equal(result.metadata.mode, "deterministic_fallback");
    assert.equal(result.metadata.llm_enabled, false);
    assert.ok(result.evidence_references.length > 0);
    assert.match(result.limitation ?? "", /synthetic/i);
    assert.ok(result.explanation?.includes(result.answer), "Explanation must contain the deterministic answer.");

    console.log("PASS: Deterministic answer is preserved.");
    console.log("PASS: Evidence and synthetic-data limitation are preserved.");
    console.log("\nDEMO ASSISTANT FALLBACK TEST PASSED");
  } finally {
    if (originalKey === undefined) {
      delete process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
    } else {
      process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY = originalKey;
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.error("TEST FAILED:", error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
````

````powershell
  dimensions: Record<DimensionKey, MetricRow[]>; interpretation: string[]; limitations: string[];
};

  { key: "stage", label: "Stage", field: "stage" },
  { key: "product", label: "Product", field: "product" },
  { key: "source", label: "Acquisition source", field: "source" },
  { key: "team", label: "Team", field: "team" },
  { key: "location", label: "Location", field: "location" },
];
const metricOptions = [
  { key: "lead_count", label: "Lead count", unit: "leads" },
  { key: "total_lead_value", label: "Total observed value", unit: "unspecified units" },
  { key: "average_lead_value", label: "Average lead value", unit: "unspecified units / lead" },
  { key: "average_days_in_stage", label: "Mean days in current stage", unit: "days" },
] as const;
type MetricKey = (typeof metricOptions)[number]["key"];

type Finding = { id: string; title: string; dimension: DimensionKey; group: string; summary: string; review: string; metric: MetricKey };

function groupValue(row: MetricRow, key: DimensionKey) { return String(row[key] ?? "Unknown"); }
function getRows(key: DimensionKey) { return summary.dimensions[key] ?? []; }
function rowMetric(row: MetricRow, key: MetricKey) { return row[key]; }

export default function DemoDataIntelligencePage() {

              <div className="space-y-3" role="list" aria-label={`${activeMetric.label} by ${dimension}`}>
                {activeRows.map(row => { const label = groupValue(row, dimension); const value = rowMetric(row, metric); const selected = selectedGroup === label; return <button role="listitem" type="button" key={label} onClick={() => { setSelectedGroup(label); setShowRecords(true); }} aria-pressed={selected} className={`block w-full rounded-lg p-2 text-left focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[#345ED7] ${selected ? "bg-[#EEF3FF]" : "hover:bg-[#F7F9FC]"}`}><div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm"><span className={`font-medium ${selected ? "text-[#2348B7]" : "text-[#334155]"}`}>{label}</span><span className="tabular-nums font-semibold text-[#172339]">{fmt(value)}</span></div><div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#E9EEF6]"><div className={`h-full rounded-full ${selected ? "bg-[#345ED7]" : "bg-[#7D9BE8]"}`} style={{ width: `${Math.max(2, value / maxMetric * 100)}%` }} /></div></button>; })}
              </div><p className="mt-4 text-xs leading-5 text-[#52647B]">Bars use the approved summary values for {summary.data_version}. Value units are unspecified where applicable. Current-stage snapshots do not establish historical conversion rates.</p>
            </div>
            <aside className="border-t border-[#DFE6F0] bg-[#F8FAFD] p-4 sm:p-5 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0"><p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.13em] text-[#52647B]">Selected group</p><h3 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">{selectedRow ? groupValue(selectedRow, dimension) : "No group"}</h3><dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">{selectedRow && [["Leads", fmt(selectedRow.lead_count)], ["Total value*", fmt(selectedRow.total_lead_value)], ["Average age", `${fmt(selectedRow.average_days_in_stage)} d`], ["Value share", `${fmt(selectedRow.value_share_percent)}%`]].map(([k,v]) => <div key={k} className="rounded-lg border border-[#DFE6F0] bg-white p-3"><dt className="text-xs text-[#52647B]">{k}</dt><dd className="mt-1 font-semibold text-[#172339]">{v}</dd></div>)}</dl><p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-6 text-[#52647B]">Review the records and compare context before drawing conclusions. This is synthetic demonstration data, not evidence of actual customer behavior.</p><button type="button" onClick={() => setShowMethodology(v => !v)} className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-[#CBD5E1] bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-[#334155] hover:bg-[#F1F5F9] aria-expanded={showMethodology}> {showMethodology ? "Hide methodology" : "View methodology & limitations"} </button></aside>
          </div>
          {showMethodology && <div className="border-t border-[#DFE6F0] bg-[#FFFCF4] p-4 sm:p-5"><h3 className="font-semibold">Methodology and limitations</h3><ul className="mt-2 list-disc space-y-1 pl-5 text-sm leading-6 text-[#52647B]">{summary.limitations.map(item => <li key={item}>{item}</li>)}</ul><p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[#52647B]">Data version {summary.data_version}; seed {summary.random_seed}; observation window {summary.observation_window.start} to {summary.observation_window.end}. *Currency is unspecified.</p></div>}
        </section>

        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#DFE6F0] bg-white shadow-sm"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#DFE6F0] p-4 sm:p-5"><div><p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.13em] text-[#345ED7]">Source evidence</p><h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">Contributing CRM records</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[#52647B]">{selectedRow ? `Records matching ${dimension}: ${groupValue(selectedRow, dimension)}. The list is derived from the demo lead-level dataset.` : "Select a comparison group to inspect records."}</p></div><button type="button" onClick={() => setShowRecords(v => !v)} aria-expanded={showRecords} className="rounded-lg border border-[#CBD5E1] bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-[#334155]">{showRecords ? "Hide records" : "Show records"}</button></div>
          {showRecords && <div className="p-4 sm:p-5"><div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"><label className="min-w-[220px] flex-1"><span className="sr-only">Search contributing records</span><input value={recordQuery} onChange={e => setRecordQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search ID, product, source, team or location" className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[#CBD5E1] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#172339] placeholder:text-[#64748B]" /></label><button type="button" onClick={() => setAgeSort(v => v === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc")} className="rounded-lg border border-[#CBD5E1] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#334155]">Age: {ageSort === "desc" ? "oldest first" : "youngest first"}</button><span className="text-sm text-[#52647B]">{scopedRecords.length} matching records</span></div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-[#DFE6F0]"><table className="w-full min-w-[780px] text-left text-sm"><thead className="bg-[#F4F7FB] text-xs text-[#52647B]"><tr>{["Lead ID","Date","Stage","Days in stage","Product","Source","Team","Location","Observed value*"].map(h => <th key={h} scope="col" className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 font-semibold">{h}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{scopedRecords.slice(0, 25).map(lead => <tr key={lead.id} className="border-t border-[#E7ECF3] hover:bg-[#F8FAFD]"><td className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-[#345ED7]">{lead.id}</td><td className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-2">{lead.date}</td><td className="px-3 py-2">{lead.stage}</td><td className="px-3 py-2 tabular-nums">{lead.daysInStage}</td><td className="px-3 py-2">{lead.product}</td><td className="px-3 py-2">{lead.source}</td><td className="px-3 py-2">{lead.team}</td><td className="px-3 py-2">{lead.location}</td><td className="px-3 py-2 tabular-nums">{fmt(lead.value)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div><p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[#52647B]">Showing up to 25 records at a time in this view. *Currency is unspecified. Search and age sort operate on the displayed selected group.</p>
          </div>}
        </section>

        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#DFE6F0] bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5"><div className="mb-3"><p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.13em] text-[#345ED7]">Grounded explanation</p><h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">Ask about the approved demo results</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[#52647B]">The existing demo assistant remains available. Its deterministic answer and evidence/fallback behavior are preserved.</p></div><DemoDataAssistant /></section>
        <footer className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2 border-t border-[#DFE6F0] py-4 text-xs text-[#52647B]"><span>{summary.project} · {summary.data_version} · Method version 1.0.0</span><span>Descriptive synthetic snapshot · no prediction or causal claims</span></footer>
      </div>
    </main>
````

## File: apply-phase3-uiux-fix.ps1
````powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# Run from the repository root. This script only edits:
#   src/app/demo/page.tsx
#   src/app/globals.css
# It creates timestamped backups and refuses to overwrite if the expected
# source markers are not present exactly once.

$demoPage = Join-Path (Get-Location) "src\app\demo\page.tsx"
$globalCss = Join-Path (Get-Location) "src\app\globals.css"

if (!(Test-Path $demoPage)) { throw "Could not find src\app\demo\page.tsx. Run this script from the repository root." }
if (!(Test-Path $globalCss)) { throw "Could not find src\app\globals.css. Run this script from the repository root." }

$pageText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($demoPage)
$cssText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($globalCss)

$oldMain = '<main className="relative mx-auto min-h-screen max-w-[1600px] px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">'
$newMain = '<main data-demo-ui="true" className="relative mx-auto min-h-screen max-w-[1600px] px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">'

if ($pageText.Contains('data-demo-ui="true"')) {
    Write-Host "Demo page already has data-demo-ui marker; leaving its markup unchanged."
} else {
    $count = ([regex]::Matches($pageText, [regex]::Escape($oldMain))).Count
    if ($count -ne 1) {
        throw "Expected exactly one demo main marker, found $count. No files were changed."
    }
}

$marker = "/* PHASE3_UIUX_READABILITY_OVERRIDES */"
if ($cssText.Contains($marker)) {
    throw "UI/UX override block already exists in globals.css. No files were changed; inspect the existing block first."
}

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
Copy-Item $demoPage "$demoPage.uiux-backup-$timestamp"
Copy-Item $globalCss "$globalCss.uiux-backup-$timestamp"

if (!$pageText.Contains('data-demo-ui="true"')) {
    $pageText = $pageText.Replace($oldMain, $newMain)
}

$cssOverrides = @'

/* PHASE3_UIUX_READABILITY_OVERRIDES */
/* Scoped to the synthetic demo dashboard; the production/operational routes stay unchanged. */
[data-demo-ui="true"] {
  --demo-ink: #172b4d;

  --demo-surface-soft: #f7f9fc;

  color: var(--demo-ink);

  background: #f4f7fb;
  border-radius: 0;
}

  border-color: var(--demo-border) !important;

  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 5%) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/10,

[data-demo-ui="true"] .border-white\/\[0\.07\],

}

[data-demo-ui="true"] input,
[data-demo-ui="true"] select,

  min-height: 42px;

}

[data-demo-ui="true"] input::placeholder,

}

  outline: 3px solid #80a7ff !important;

}

[data-demo-ui="true"] footer,
[data-demo-ui="true"] [class*="text-[10px]"],
[data-demo-ui="true"] [class*="text-xs"] {
  color: #52627a;
}

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  [data-demo-ui="true"] {
    padding-left: 12px;
    padding-right: 12px;
  }

  [data-demo-ui="true"] section {
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-demo-ui="true"] *,
  [data-demo-ui="true"] *::before,
  [data-demo-ui="true"] *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

$pageText = $pageText.Replace($oldMain, $newMain)
$cssText = $cssText.TrimEnd() + "`r`n`r`n" + $cssOverrides.Trim() + "`r`n"

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($demoPage, $pageText, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($globalCss, $cssText, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Applied scoped UI readability fixes."

Write-Host "  $demoPage.uiux-backup-$timestamp"
````

## File: Dockerfile.part-a
````
FROM node:20-bookworm-slim AS builder

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 && \
    ln -s /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci

COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:20-bookworm-slim AS runner

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0

RUN groupadd --system --gid 1001 nextjs && \
    useradd --system --uid 1001 --gid nextjs nextjs

COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nextjs /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nextjs /app/.next/static ./.next/static
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nextjs /app/data ./data

USER nextjs

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "server.js"]
````

## File: assistant/core/intent-resolver.ts
````typescript
import type {
  AssistantDimension,
  AssistantIntent,
  AssistantStatus,
  IntentResolution,
} from "./contracts";

const DIMENSIONS: Record<AssistantDimension, string[]> = {
  stage: ["Lead", "Qualified", "Opportunity", "Proposal", "Won", "Lost"],
  product: ["Payments", "Analytics", "Security"],
  source: ["Website", "Partner", "Referral", "Campaign"],
};

function result(
  status: AssistantStatus,
  intent: AssistantIntent | null,
  message: string,
  extra: Partial<IntentResolution> = {},
): IntentResolution {
  return { status, intent, message, ...extra };
}

function findDimension(question: string): AssistantDimension | undefined {
  const q = question.toLowerCase();
  const matches: AssistantDimension[] = [];

  if (/\bstages?\b/.test(q)) matches.push("stage");
  if (/\bproducts?\b/.test(q)) matches.push("product");

  if (
    /\b(sources?|acquisition channels?)\b/.test(q)
  ) {
    matches.push("source");
  }

  return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : undefined;
}

function findGroups(
  question: string,
  dimension: AssistantDimension,
): string[] {
  return DIMENSIONS[dimension].filter((group) =>
    new RegExp(
      `\\b${group.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")}\\b`,
      "i",
    ).test(question),
  );
}

export function resolveIntent(question: string): IntentResolution {
  const q = question.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  const lower = q.toLowerCase();

  if (
    /\b(what is|give me|show me|provide|summari[sz]e)\b/.test(lower) &&
    /\b(approved )?(summary|overview|key findings)\b/.test(lower)
  ) {
    return result("SUPPORTED", "get_summary", "Approved summary requested.");
  }

  if (
    /\b(data version|method version|freshness|when was .*generated|generated at)\b/.test(
      lower,
    )
  ) {
    return result(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_data_freshness",
      "Approved data and method metadata requested.",
    );
  }

  if (
    /\b(limitations?|caveats|weak cases|small sample sizes?)\b/.test(lower) &&
    !/\b(which|what|list|show)\b.{0,30}\b(groups?|categories)\b/.test(lower)
  ) {
    return result(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "explain_limitation",
      "Documented limitations requested.",
    );
  }

  if (
    /\b(methodology|method|how was .*analysis performed|how is .*analysis performed)\b/.test(
      lower,
    )
  ) {
    return result(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "explain_method",
      "Approved methodology requested.",
    );
  }

  if (
    /\b(fewer than five|less than five|under five|small group warnings?)\b/.test(
      lower,
    ) ||
    /\b(groups?|categories)\b.{0,40}\b(fewer than|less than|under)\s+5\b/.test(
      lower,
    )
  ) {
    return result(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "get_small_group_warnings",
      "Approved small-group warnings requested.",
    );
  }

  // Reject average-value rankings unless an approved comparison metric exists.
  if (
    /\b(highest|largest|top|most)\b/.test(lower) &&
    /\b(average lead value|average value|mean lead value)\b/.test(lower) &&
    /\b(stages?|products?|sources?|acquisition channels?)\b/.test(lower)
  ) {
    return result(
      "UNAVAILABLE",
      "compare_groups",
      "The approved comparison results do not provide average lead value rankings for stages, products, or acquisition sources. Only approved total lead value comparisons are available.",
      { dimension: findDimension(q) },
    );
  }

  const resultIdMatch = q.match(
    /\b(baseline_[a-z_]+|stage_[a-z_]+_total_value|product_[a-z_]+_total_value|source_[a-z_]+_total_value)\b/i,
  );

  if (
    /\b(explain|describe|details for|tell me about)\b/.test(lower) &&
    resultIdMatch
  ) {
    return result(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "explain_result",
      "A specific approved result was requested.",
      { result_id: resultIdMatch[1].toLowerCase() },
    );
  }

  const dimension = findDimension(q);

  if (
    /\b(compare|difference between|versus|vs\.?)\b/.test(lower) &&
    dimension
  ) {
    const groups = findGroups(q, dimension);

    if (groups.length === 0) {
      return result(
        "MISSING_PARAMETER",
        "compare_groups",
        `Please name two approved ${dimension} groups to compare.`,
        { dimension },
      );
    }

    if (groups.length === 1) {
      return result(
        "MISSING_PARAMETER",
        "compare_groups",
        `Please name a second approved ${dimension} group to compare with ${groups[0]}.`,
        { dimension, group_a: groups[0] },
      );
    }

    if (groups.length > 2) {
      return result(
        "AMBIGUOUS",
        "compare_groups",
        "Please compare exactly two approved groups in one question.",
        { dimension },
      );
    }

    return result(
      "SUPPORTED",
      "compare_groups",
      `Compare ${groups[0]} with ${groups[1]} for ${dimension}.`,
      { dimension, group_a: groups[0], group_b: groups[1] },
    );
  }

  if (
    /\b(highest|largest|top|most)\b/.test(lower) &&
    /\b(total lead value|lead value|total value)\b/.test(lower)
  ) {
    if (dimension) {
      return result(
        "SUPPORTED",
        "compare_groups",
        `Highest approved total lead value requested for ${dimension}.`,
        { dimension },
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    /\b(explain|describe|details for|tell me about)\b/.test(lower) &&
    /\b(analysis|result|finding|track a)\b/.test(lower)
  ) {
    return result(
      "MISSING_PARAMETER",
      "explain_result",
      "Please provide an approved result ID or name a specific approved group.",
    );
  }

  return result(
    "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
    null,
    "I could not match that question to an approved question pattern. Try asking for the approved summary, a highest-total-value stage/product/source, a comparison of two named groups, methodology, limitations, data version, or small-group warnings.",
  );
}
````

## File: assistant/core/response-validator.ts
````typescript
import type { AssistantResponse } from "./contracts";

const MAX_EVIDENCE_REFERENCES = 10;
const MAX_FOLLOW_UPS = 3;

export function validateAssistantResponse(
  response: AssistantResponse,
): AssistantResponse {
  const invalid =
    !response.answer_id ||
    !response.status ||
    typeof response.answer !== "string" ||
    !response.metadata ||
    !Array.isArray(response.evidence_references) ||
    !Array.isArray(response.suggested_follow_ups) ||
    !response.key_values ||
    typeof response.key_values !== "object";

  if (invalid) {
    return {
      ...response,
      status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      intent: null,
      answer: "I could not validate the response. Please try an approved question again.",
      evidence_references: [],
      key_values: {},
      limitation: "The response did not satisfy the required response contract.",
      suggested_follow_ups: [
        "What is the approved summary?",
        "What are the documented limitations?",
      ],
    };
  }

  const evidence = response.evidence_references.slice(
    0,
    MAX_EVIDENCE_REFERENCES,
  );

  const followUps = response.suggested_follow_ups
    .filter((item) => typeof item === "string" && item.trim().length > 0)
    .slice(0, MAX_FOLLOW_UPS);

  const factualStatuses = ["SUPPORTED"];

  if (
    factualStatuses.includes(response.status) &&
    evidence.length === 0
  ) {
    return {
      ...response,
      status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      intent: null,
      answer:
        "I cannot provide a factual answer because approved supporting evidence is unavailable.",
      evidence_references: [],
      key_values: {},
      limitation: "No approved evidence references were attached to the response.",
      suggested_follow_ups: [
        "What is the approved summary?",
        "What data version is being used?",
      ],
    };
  }

  return {
    ...response,
    evidence_references: evidence,
    suggested_follow_ups: followUps,
  };
}
````

## File: assistant/core/scope-guard.ts
````typescript
import type { AssistantStatus } from "./contracts";

export type ScopeGuardResult = {
  status: AssistantStatus;
  normalizedQuestion: string;
  message: string;
};

const MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH = 500;

const UNSAFE_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  /ignore\s+(all\s+)?(previous|prior|above)\s+instructions/i,
  /reveal\s+(the\s+)?(system\s+prompt|hidden\s+instructions|secrets?)/i,
  /(system\s+prompt|hidden\s+instructions)/i,
  /\b(api[_ -]?keys?|passwords?|credentials|access tokens?)\b/i,
  /\b(print|dump|show|export|reveal)\b.{0,40}\b(raw dataset|all raw records|all lead records|private records)\b/i,
  /\b(run|execute)\b.{0,30}\b(sql|python|javascript|arbitrary code|shell commands?)\b/i,
];

const OUT_OF_SCOPE_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  /\b(predict|forecast|prediction|future conversion|propensity score)\b/i,
  /\b(caus(al|ation)|caused by|impact of|prove that)\b/i,
  /\b(generate|invent|change|alter|fabricate)\b.{0,35}\b(scores?|rankings?|findings?|results?|numbers?)\b/i,
  /\b(employee|personnel|customer email|phone number|personal address)\b/i,
  /\b(write|execute|run)\b.{0,30}\b(sql|python|javascript|code)\b/i,
];

export function checkQuestionScope(question: unknown): ScopeGuardResult {
  if (typeof question !== "string") {
    return {
      status: "MISSING_PARAMETER",
      normalizedQuestion: "",
      message: "Please enter a question about the approved Data Intelligence results.",
    };
  }

  const normalizedQuestion = question.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");

  if (!normalizedQuestion) {
    return {
      status: "MISSING_PARAMETER",
      normalizedQuestion: "",
      message: "Please enter a question about the approved Data Intelligence results.",
    };
  }

  if (normalizedQuestion.length > MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH) {
    return {
      status: "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      normalizedQuestion: "",
      message: "Questions must be 500 characters or fewer.",
    };
  }

  if (UNSAFE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(normalizedQuestion))) {
    return {
      status: "UNSAFE",
      normalizedQuestion,
      message:
        "I cannot help with requests to expose protected instructions, credentials, raw records, or execute arbitrary code. Ask about the approved aggregate intelligence results instead.",
    };
  }

  if (OUT_OF_SCOPE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(normalizedQuestion))) {
    return {
      status: "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      normalizedQuestion,
      message:
        "That request is outside the approved descriptive-analysis scope. I can answer questions using the existing Track A intelligence results, methodology, data version, and documented limitations.",
    };
  }

  return {
    status: "SUPPORTED",
    normalizedQuestion,
    message: "Question passed the initial scope check.",
  };
}
````

## File: assistant/queries/intelligence-queries.ts
````typescript
import resultsDocument from "../../src/data/intelligence/intelligence_results.json";
import summaryDocument from "../../src/data/intelligence/intelligence_summary.json";

import type {
  AssistantDimension,
  AssistantEvidenceReference,
} from "../core/contracts";

import type {
  IntelligenceResult,
  IntelligenceSummary,
} from "../../src/types/intelligence";

const results = resultsDocument.results as IntelligenceResult[];
const summary = summaryDocument as IntelligenceSummary;

const QUALITY_STATUS = "VALIDATED_DESCRIPTIVE" as const;

export function getApprovedSummary(): IntelligenceSummary {
  return summary;
}

export function getApprovedResultById(
  resultId: string,
): IntelligenceResult | undefined {
  return results.find((item) => item.result_id === resultId);
}

export function getApprovedResultsByDimension(
  dimension: AssistantDimension,
): IntelligenceResult[] {
  const resultTypeByDimension: Record<AssistantDimension, string> = {
    stage: "stage_comparison",
    product: "product_comparison",
    source: "source_comparison",
  };

  return results.filter(
    (item) =>
      item.result_type === resultTypeByDimension[dimension] &&
      item.metric_name === "total_lead_value",
  );
}

export function getApprovedGroupResult(
  dimension: AssistantDimension,
  group: string,
): IntelligenceResult | undefined {
  const normalizedGroup = group.trim().toLowerCase();

  return getApprovedResultsByDimension(dimension).find(
    (item) => item.group_key?.trim().toLowerCase() === normalizedGroup,
  );
}

export function getSmallGroupWarnings(): IntelligenceResult[] {
  return getApprovedResultsByDimension("stage").filter(
    (item) => (item.evidence.lead_count ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) < 5,
  );
}

export function buildResultEvidence(
  result: IntelligenceResult,
): AssistantEvidenceReference {
  return {
    source_id: result.result_id,
    source_type: "intelligence_result",
    result_id: result.result_id,
    group: result.group_key ?? undefined,
    metric: result.metric_name,
    value: result.result_value,
    unit: result.result_unit,
    finding: result.finding,
    evidence: result.evidence,
    data_version: result.data_version,
    method_version: result.method_version,
    generated_at: result.generated_at,
    quality_status: result.quality_status,
    limitation: result.limitation,
  };
}

export function buildSummaryEvidence(): AssistantEvidenceReference {
  return {
    source_id: "intelligence_summary.json",
    source_type: "intelligence_summary",
    data_version: summary.data_version,
    method_version: summary.method_version,
    generated_at: summary.generated_at,
    quality_status: QUALITY_STATUS,
    limitation: summary.limitations.join(" "),
  };
}
````

## File: data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/assumptions.md
````markdown
# Phase 3 Demo Dataset Assumptions — phase3-demo-v1

**Classification:** SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA - NOT REAL CUSTOMER DATA

## Purpose and isolation
This is a reproducible synthetic demonstration dataset. It does not represent actual customers, actual transactions, or measured business outcomes. It is stored under `data/demo/phase3-demo-v1/` and does not overwrite the `phase3-v2` baseline files.

## Dataset and reproducibility
- Source leads: 600; fixed random seed: `20261017`.
- Observation dates are sampled across the 12-calendar-month window 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30.
- Each source lead generates exactly two canonical rows: `lead_value` and `days_in_stage`.
- Expected canonical rows: 1200; canonical schema uses the same 20 columns and order as the baseline.
- All source and canonical records carry `is_synthetic=true` and `data_version=phase3-demo-v1`. Each source row also carries a synthetic-data notice.

## Generation assumptions (invented for demonstration, not empirical estimates)
- Stage weights: `{"Lead": 0.18, "Lost": 0.1, "Opportunity": 0.2, "Proposal": 0.16, "Qualified": 0.2, "Won": 0.16}`.
- Product weights: `{"Analytics": 0.33, "Payments": 0.42, "Security": 0.25}`.
- Acquisition-source weights: `{"Campaign": 0.26, "Partner": 0.16, "Referral": 0.24, "Website": 0.34}`.
- Team weights: `{"Enterprise": 0.35, "Growth": 0.25, "SMB": 0.4}`.
- Location weights: `{"Bangalore": 0.24, "Chennai": 0.15, "Delhi": 0.17, "Hyderabad": 0.14, "Mumbai": 0.2, "Pune": 0.1}`.
- Lead value starts from a product-specific range (Payments 25,000–175,000; Analytics 20,000–130,000; Security 15,000–100,000), is scaled by team (Enterprise 1.35, Growth 1.0, SMB 0.75), and rounded to the nearest 1,000. Values have unspecified currency units.
- Days-in-stage ranges depend on current stage: Lead 1–12; Qualified 3–20; Opportunity 5–35; Proposal 4–30; Won 2–25; Lost 5–45.
- Dates, stages, products, sources, teams, locations, and values are independently randomized within the documented rules. No stage-transition history is generated; this snapshot must not be used to claim conversion probabilities, causal effects, or predictive performance.

## Limitations
Distributions are designed to create varied demonstration scenarios, not to estimate a real sales population. Comparisons are descriptive only. Month-level lead counts reflect the seeded random draw, not seasonality.
````

## File: data/quality/sampling_report.md
````markdown
# Sampling and Reduction Report

## 1. Source Dataset

The Phase 2 CRM source is located at:

`src/data/crmData.ts`

The extracted source sample is:

`data/source-sample/source_sample.csv`

The source contains **30 CRM lead records**.

## 2. Sampling Decision

No statistical or random sampling was applied.

All 30 available source records were retained because the source dataset is already substantially below the Phase 3 default limit of 10,000 rows.

Therefore:

- Source records available: 30
- Records retained: 30
- Records removed: 0
- Sampling method: Full retention
- Random seed: Not applicable

## 3. Reason for Full Retention

Reducing the dataset further would unnecessarily remove available project data.

The complete source dataset is small enough to remain within the Phase 3 data-package limits while preserving the existing Phase 2 coverage.

## 4. Coverage Preserved

The retained records preserve the source dimensions available in the Phase 2 application, including:

- Lead identifiers
- Observation dates
- Locations
- Teams
- Products
- Lead sources
- Funnel stages
- Days in stage
- Lead values

Observed funnel stages include:

- Lead
- Qualified
- Opportunity
- Proposal
- Won
- Lost

## 5. Date Range

The source records currently span:

**2026-01-05 to 2026-03-20**

The complete date range is retained.

## 6. Canonical Expansion

The 30 retained source records are transformed into canonical records during standardization.

Each source lead produces:

1. One `crm_lead` record representing the lead value.
2. One `crm_lead_metric` record representing `days_in_stage`.

Therefore:

- Source records: 30
- Canonical records after transformation: 60

This is a transformation of the retained source records, not additional source data.

## 7. Reduction Result

No source records were discarded during sampling or reduction.

The canonical transformation preserves the important source fields through the canonical mapping documented in:

`docs/CANONICAL_DATA_MAPPING.md`

## 8. Limitations

The source dataset contains only 30 records.

The repository also does not document whether the source data is synthetic, anonymized, or derived from a real operational system.

This provenance status must be confirmed before final canonical-package approval.

## 9. Reproducibility

The sampling decision is deterministic.

The sampling pipeline reads the controlled source sample and retains all available records.

No random selection is performed.

## 10. Status

**SAMPLING COMPLETE — ALL AVAILABLE SOURCE RECORDS RETAINED**
````

## File: data/README.md
````markdown
# Phase 3 Canonical Data Package

## Purpose

This directory contains the controlled local data package created for Phase 3 of the Lead Funnel Conversion Observatory.

The package provides a standardized data foundation for future Phase 3 analysis.

## Source

The current Phase 2 application data is defined in:

`src/data/crmData.ts`

The extracted source sample is stored at:

`data/source-sample/source_sample.csv`

The source contains 30 records and 9 fields.

## Canonical Source of Truth

The single canonical source of truth for Phase 3 analysis is:

`data/canonical/intelligence_data.csv`

Future Phase 3 analysis should use this canonical dataset rather than directly reading the original Phase 2 TypeScript data.

## Package Structure

```text
data/
├── README.md
├── manifest.json
├── schema.json
├── source-sample/
│   └── source_sample.csv
├── canonical/
│   └── intelligence_data.csv
├── published/
│   └── intelligence_data.json
└── quality/
    ├── data_profile.json
    ├── validation_report.json
    └── sampling_report.md
````

## File: data-science/scripts/track-specific/track_a_comparative_analysis.py
````python
"""
POC-7 Phase 3
Track A - Comparative Intelligence

Track-specific reusable analytical module.

Purpose:
Provide reusable functions for descriptive comparison of:
- Funnel stage
- Product category
- Acquisition source

The module uses one source CRM lead as the analytical unit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Dict, Tuple

import pandas as pd


METHOD_VERSION = "1.0.0"


def build_analytical_dataset(
    canonical_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Reconstruct one analytical row per source CRM lead.

    Expected canonical record types:
    - crm_lead
    - crm_lead_metric
    """

    source_leads = canonical_df[
        canonical_df["record_type"] == "crm_lead"
    ].copy()

    metric_records = canonical_df[
        canonical_df["record_type"] == "crm_lead_metric"
    ].copy()

    if source_leads.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "No crm_lead records were found in the canonical dataset."
        )

    if metric_records.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "No crm_lead_metric records were found in the canonical dataset."
        )

    # One metric record per entity containing observed days in stage.
    days_by_entity = (
        metric_records
        .set_index("entity_id")["metric_value"]
        .astype(float)
    )

    analysis = source_leads[
        [
            "entity_id",
            "stage",
            "category",
            "subcategory",
            "metric_value",
        ]
    ].copy()

    analysis = analysis.rename(
        columns={
            "metric_value": "lead_value"
        }
    )

    analysis["days_in_stage"] = (
        analysis["entity_id"]
        .map(days_by_entity)
    )

    if analysis["lead_value"].isna().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing lead values detected in the analytical dataset."
        )

    if analysis["days_in_stage"].isna().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing days-in-stage values detected in the analytical dataset."
        )

    return analysis.reset_index(drop=True)


def calculate_baseline(
    analysis_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """
    Calculate the approved descriptive baseline.
    """

    return {
        "lead_count": int(len(analysis_df)),
        "total_lead_value": float(
            analysis_df["lead_value"].sum()
        ),
        "average_lead_value": float(
            analysis_df["lead_value"].mean()
        ),
        "average_days_in_stage": float(
            analysis_df["days_in_stage"].mean()
        ),
        "median_days_in_stage": float(
            analysis_df["days_in_stage"].median()
        ),
    }


def _summarize_dimension(
    analysis_df: pd.DataFrame,
    dimension: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Summarize one approved comparison dimension.
    """

    summary = (
        analysis_df
        .groupby(dimension, dropna=False)
        .agg(
            lead_count=("entity_id", "count"),
            total_lead_value=("lead_value", "sum"),
            average_lead_value=("lead_value", "mean"),
            average_days_in_stage=("days_in_stage", "mean"),
            median_days_in_stage=("days_in_stage", "median"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    total_value = analysis_df["lead_value"].sum()

    if total_value == 0:
        summary["value_share_percent"] = 0.0
    else:
        summary["value_share_percent"] = (
            summary["total_lead_value"] / total_value * 100.0
        )

    # Deterministic ranking:
    # primary = total observed lead value descending
    # secondary = group label ascending
    summary = summary.sort_values(
        by=[
            "total_lead_value",
            dimension,
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            True,
        ],
        na_position="last",
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    summary["priority_rank"] = (
        summary.index + 1
    )

    return summary


def compare_track_a(
    analysis_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Generate all approved Track A comparative summaries.
    """

    dimensions = {
        "stage": "stage",
        "product": "category",
        "source": "subcategory",
    }

    return {
        output_name: _summarize_dimension(
            analysis_df,
            column_name,
        )
        for output_name, column_name in dimensions.items()
    }


def run_track_a(
    canonical_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, Dict[str, float], Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]]:
    """
    Complete reusable Track A calculation.

    Returns:
        analytical dataset
        baseline
        comparative summaries
    """

    analysis = build_analytical_dataset(
        canonical_df
    )

    baseline = calculate_baseline(
        analysis
    )

    comparisons = compare_track_a(
        analysis
    )

    return (
        analysis,
        baseline,
        comparisons,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(
        "Track A Comparative Intelligence module loaded successfully."
    )
    print(
        f"Method version: {METHOD_VERSION}"
    )
````

````python
print("Output:", output_path)
````
